description: List all checks in the project, optionally filtered by slug and/or tags. Returns {checks:[...]} — each check's status, schedule, last ping, and ping URL. Healthchecks: GET /checks/.

slug.description: Filter to checks with this exact slug.

tag.description: Filter to checks carrying ALL of these tags (each is sent as a separate `tag` query param).

name: healthchecksio_list_checks
title: List checks
